criteria: SDK Tasarımı — Vibecoding-Uyumlu App Üretimi kapsamı + kuyruk paydaş onayı
requirements.notes: W0.11 salt-okunur readiness gap: /Users/karaca/DEV/mimari/platform icinde packages/sdk yok; yalniz packages/ui var. API tarafinda runtime Strawberry schema var ancak public SDK contract, codegen, generated client, app-core/module template veya SDK test paketi yok. Bkz docs/be-sdk-readiness-gap-2026-07-09.md. Wave 2 readiness gap: SDK app-core/module template, generator guardrails, OrderOps/Inventory repeatability proof ve diff report henuz yok; Customer slice yesil olmadan W2 product code baslatilmaz. Bkz docs/wave2-sdk-repeatability-readiness-gap-2026-07-09.md. Initial 11 PR handoff: PR-10 packages/sdk public contract, deterministic codegen, manual-edit guard ve forbidden-stack tests tasir; full generator CLI non-goal kalir. Bkz docs/platform-initial-11-pr-execution-handoff-2026-07-09.md. Wave 2 PR handoff: SDK app-core template, module template, generator guardrails ve repeatability diff report tamamlanmadan SDK repeatability verified sayilmaz. Bkz docs/platform-wave2-repeatability-pr-handoff-2026-07-09.md. Execution queue: Foundation, Customer, Wave 2, Wave 3 ve Wave 4 PR zinciri reports/platform-implementation-execution-queue-2026-07-09.json icinde machine-readable olarak izlenir; mevcut next-actionable yalniz PR-01 task/platform-cicd-ci-baseline itemidir. PR-10 agent pack: packages/sdk public contract, public API snapshot, deterministic codegen, generated-output manual-edit guard ve forbidden-stack guard evidence sozlesmesi hazirdir; full generator CLI, app/module template ve Customer/domain CRUD non-goal olarak kilitlidir. Bkz docs/platform-pr10-sdk-public-contract-agent-pack-2026-07-09.md. W2-01 agent pack: SDK app-core template manifest, route/menu shell, capability binding, event namespace skeleton, deterministic render, generated-header/manual-edit guard compatibility ve forbidden-stack scan evidence sozlesmesi hazirdir; SDK module template, full generator CLI ve domain scaffold non-goal olarak kilitlidir. Bkz docs/platform-w2-01-sdk-app-core-template-agent-pack-2026-07-09.md. W2-02 agent pack: SDK module template manifest, healthz fixture, permission fixture, deterministic render ve test harness evidence sozlesmesi hazirdir; generator guardrails, marketplace runtime ve domain scaffold non-goal olarak kilitlidir. Bkz docs/platform-w2-02-sdk-module-template-agent-pack-2026-07-09.md. W2-03 agent pack: generator manual-edit guard, forbidden-stack guard, missing-test no-go, byte-stable output ve deterministic guardrail report evidence sozlesmesi hazirdir; domain feature, marketplace runtime ve plugin loading non-goal olarak kilitlidir. Bkz docs/platform-w2-03-sdk-generator-guardrails-agent-pack-2026-07-09.md. W2-06 agent pack: Customer/OrderOps/Inventory repeatability report, copy-code threshold, generator/template evidence refs ve Wave 2 exit evidence sozlesmesi hazirdir; yeni domain ve Wave 3 feature non-goal olarak kilitlidir. Bkz docs/platform-w2-06-sdk-repeatability-diff-report-agent-pack-2026-07-09.md.

owasp.title: OWASP & Standartlar
items: A08 Integrity: SDK şablonları imzalı paket ve SBOM ile yayınlanır; imza/SBOM doğrulaması geçmeyen scaffold üretimi reddedilir
A05 Misconfiguration: güvenli üretim varsayılanı ASVS L2 kontrol listesiyle gelir; debug flag, geniş CORS ve açık secret örnek değeri CI'da fail olur
A03 Injection: scaffold değişkenleri ve AI'dan gelen template parametreleri Zod input validation + allowlist üzerinden geçer; shell/SQL/JS injection payload'ları encode veya deny edilir
A01 Access Control: MIT/API-boundary rolü least-privilege çalışır; AI app/module üretemez/güncelleyemez ve ruleset override edemez sınırı ECA deny kaydıyla korunur
A09 Logging: sdk app create, dry-run diff, onay/red ve paket publish adımları append-only audit izine userId, scaffoldId, templateVersion ve sözleşme hash'iyle yazılır
